title: Chapter 372 Bombing
content:
Chapter 372 Bombing

And it is these remaining demigods who have conflicts with each other, and they are divided into several camps, faintly confronting each other with the three noble gods as the core.

As for the existence below demigods, although their strength is not weak, there is a fundamental difference to demigods who have reached the divine life, which is no less than the difference between human beings and ants, and it will not cause much hindrance at all.

Therefore, Zhong Yu brought so many people here, which is not worth mentioning compared to the strength of the entire Gao Tianyuan. They are just used to support the scene and fight to solve some small troubles.

Really expecting these people to help him pacify the entire Gaotianyuan, how much effort he will make in this war is completely a joke.

This battle of gods began planning from the moment Tomita Yoshinari was defeated, and began to form a 200,000 army to start a decisive battle with the Kwantung Allied Forces.

While the mortal army went south to wipe out the princes of the Guandong, Zhong Yu also led his elite army into Gaotianyuan, launching a large-scale war from the two places of the human world and the divine world.

This world is very powerful, at least among the worlds that Zhong Yu has seen, only the Western world of gods and demons at the beginning is more powerful than this world, and other worlds are far behind.

Not only do there exist more than half-god powers, but there are more than one, and there are two creator gods who are close to the true gods and have already ignited the divine fire, only short of condensing the godhead.

And there is also a real world divided into yin and yang, the world of the human world, and Gao Tianyuan where the world of gods and the world of the underworld are mixed.

This is not simple, it means that this world already has yin and yang reincarnation, can give birth to souls independently, and can be self-sufficient without resorting to the chaos of the great way to generate souls.

This is an incredible breakthrough. At this point, the personality of the world is much higher than those worlds with only the pure human world, and they are no longer in the same class in essence.

Similarly, the two points of the world represent the origin of the world, that is, the precious luck is also divided into two points.

A copy is stored in the human world, which is the world that Zhongyu Dojo is currently conquering. There is also a Gaotianyuan stored under the feet of the present, and the specific manifestations are the gods worshiped by the mortals.

Even because of humanistic beliefs, many of the luck in the human world are absorbed into Gao Tianyuan, making Gao Tianyuan's proportion of luck far greater than that in the human world, and it is a place with a strong charm.

Killing a master of the same class here, the luck gained is several times that of the human world, and if it is still a famous god, the luck will be even more.

So when Susanoo took the initiative to attack and caused a lot of losses to the dojo army, Zhong Yu not only didn't feel unhappy, but felt resentful, on the contrary, he felt secretly happy.

There is too little luck in the world, even if Zhong Yu harvested a large wave of luck by killing chickens and taking eggs, it still couldn't satisfy his consumption.

Up to now, Zhong Yu's strength has just recovered to the sixth level, that is, the cultivation base of a demigod.

As for breaking through to the more advanced seventh level, to reach the level of the two Japanese creator gods, more luck is needed.

If he could slaughter the whole of Japan and kill all the creatures in the human world, he could barely break through to this level of cultivation.

But if you do this, you will wake up the heavens, and if you are hungry, you will also attract hostility from humanity, and even the two creator gods, Izanagi and Izanami, who are already sleeping, will be awakened by this disaster.

At that time, so many powerful enemies will unanimously point their finger at him, it will be irresistible.

Therefore, he could only turn around and set his target on Gao Tianyuan.

The humanitarian belief here is extremely strong, and a lot of luck has been gathered. The ratio of the total amount to the human world is about 2:1, which is twice as much.

However, the number of living beings in Gao Tianyuan is very small. Although they are called gods, only seven people have truly reached the level of demigods, and the rest are just some ordinary people.

Although only seven demigods accounted for half of Gao Tianyuan's luck, the remaining mortals were equivalent to the entire human world.

Zhong Yu didn't have that extravagant hope of beheading a demigod with the same cultivation level as himself.

Not to mention that the cultivation base is equal, even if one's own strength is quite strong among the same level, one can fight against several. But this is their home field after all, it is still very difficult to really kill a person of the same level.

Besides, there are too many people of the same level in Gao Tianyuan, and although there are conflicts, they all come from the same source, and when their lives are truly threatened, they will definitely join forces to deal with themselves, and some dangers may arise at that time.

So the target is inevitably placed on the mundane under those demigods.

These ordinary demons, who are numerous in number but quite weak in strength, are all carrying strong luck, like pieces of fat that can walk away, and they will kill anyone if they don't kill them.

So although Zhong Yu said that he was attacking Gao Tianyuan, his real target was these ordinary monsters.

He was not prepared to fight those demigods ruthlessly from the beginning.

As soon as he broke into Gao Tianyuan, Zhong Yu immediately released several big moves with a huge range of damage, in the eyes of those monsters who were looking at him curiously, he invested their fatal power.

As a result, several attacks that shook the entire Gaotianyuan appeared, tens of thousands of ordinary monsters died, and corpses everywhere covered the entire land.

All the monsters in Gaotianyuan were alarmed, and then they panicked and ran for their lives.

However, although Gao Tianyuan nominally belongs to the same two realms as the Human Realm, and has the same personality, but the scale is far smaller. It is equivalent to a Deyu Kingdom, which is very small, but only a hundred miles away.

Such a small distance, for a highly cultivated demigod, is only a matter of a few steps.

The powerful and dense attacks kept tilting. Zhong Yu, who had been prepared for a long time, had already prepared dozens of powerful attacks in his body when he attacked Gao Tianyuan.

Now, these attacks have finally come in handy for what they should be.

Each throw is enough to destroy the land for several miles and kill tens of thousands of people.

Dozens of them were thrown out in just one minute, covering the entire Gao Tianyuan, without missing a single bit.

When all kinds of brilliance lit up and finally disappeared, the entire Gaotianyuan fell into a calm state, and it was completely reduced to a piece of scorched earth. Endless gunpowder smoke rose everywhere, and wailing everywhere appeared constantly.

There were more than 100,000 monsters, and under this round of bombing, only more than 3,000 people survived in the end.

These are some people with high strength, or have powerful life-saving moves, or simply some lucky people, so they barely survived.

Such a cruel massacre almost destroyed the foundation of the entire Gaotianyuan, and it was undoubtedly a provocation to the demigods such as the Sanguishen.

So the grumpy and most unbearable Susano jumped out and acted as a questioning stone for the rest of the people.

This is why Zhong Yu fought Susanoo just now.
